title: ORDER BY with two descending keys orders tied rows by the second key
query: EVALUATE Player ORDER BY Player[Score] DESC, Player[Name] DESC

source.quote: It can include only columns that are part of EVALUATE or expressions that can be computed in the row context of the result.
source.supports: the keys are columns of the result
each key has its own direction

derivation: Player scores: Ann 90, Bob 80, Cho 80, Dee 70, Eve 70, Fay 50. By score descending; within the 80s and the 70s by name descending: Cho before Bob, Eve before Dee.
